verify.answer: Neither answer is quite right as phrased, because Argentina has no standalone trade ministry — but for an ITA briefing the minister-level trade counterpart is Pablo Quirno, not Pablo Lavigne. Quirno became Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Trade and Worship (Canciller) in October 2025 — announced Oct 23, sworn in Oct 27, succeeding Gerardo Werthein (resigned Oct 22) — and international trade policy sits in his ministry; he remains in office as of July 2026 (publicly active as Canciller in early July 2026). Pablo Lavigne is NOT a minister: he is Secretary of Production Coordination inside the Economy Ministry (since Dec 11, 2024, Decree 1098/2024), and since Decree 215/2026 (published Mar 31, 2026) he additionally exercises the functions of the vacant Secretariat of Industry and Commerce/SMEs on an acting basis — making him the top official for DOMESTIC commerce and industry. Working-level counterpart for external trade negotiations is Fernando Brun, Secretary of International Economic Relations under the Cancillería (confirmed active May 2026). Digital lead reconfirmed: Darío Leandro Genua, Secretary of Innovation, Science and Technology (Chief of Cabinet's Office), who opened the Argentina Digital Summit 2026 on April 22, 2026.
verify.division_note_trade: External trade policy and negotiations sit with the Cancillería (Canciller Pablo Quirno, with Fernando Brun as Secretary of International Economic Relations); domestic commerce, industry and SME policy sits in the Economy Ministry under Pablo Lavigne (acting over the vacant Industry & Commerce secretariat per Decree 215/2026).
verify.division_note_digital: Digital and tech policy is led from the Chief of Cabinet's Office via the Secretariat of Innovation, Science and Technology (Darío Genua) — there is no standalone digital ministry.
corrections: Quirno's succession dates: Werthein resigned Oct 22, 2025; Quirno's appointment was announced Oct 23 and he was sworn in Oct 27, 2025 — so 'assumed office' should be cited as Oct 27, 2025 (some databases list Oct 23).

Lavigne's acting Industry & Commerce role via Decree 215/2026 is explicitly temporary — 'until the coverage of the Secretariat is arranged' — so it may lapse if a permanent Secretary of Industry and Commerce is named; re-check before publication.
Neither Quirno nor Lavigne holds the literal title 'Trade Minister' — Argentina folds international trade into the Foreign Ministry and domestic commerce into the Economy Ministry.

usTotals.source: U.S. Census Bureau / U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, FT-900 "U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, December and Annual 2025" (released February 2026)
usTotals.notes: Full-year 2025 U.S. total (world) goods trade, nominal USD, balance-of-payments basis as published in the FT-900 annual release: goods exports $2,197.5B (up $117.7B from 2024; highest on record), goods imports $3,438.4B (up $143.2B; highest on record), goods deficit $1,240.9B (highest on record). Figures reconcile exactly: 2,197.5 - 3,438.4 = -1,240.9. Confirmed via live web search on 2026-07-16 against the BEA release page (bea.gov/news/2026/us-international-trade-goods-and-services-december-and-annual-2025), the BEA PDF (bea.gov/sites/default/files/2026-02/trad1225.pdf), and Census Annual 2025 Press Highlights (census.gov/foreign-trade/statistics/highlights/AnnualPressHighlights.pdf). Direct fetch of .gov PDFs was blocked by the environment's egress proxy (403), so figures were verified via search excerpts of those official pages; the three independent excerpts are mutually consistent and reconcile arithmetically. 2025 services surplus was $339.5B (context, not part of goods figures).

seal.notes: Fetched live 2026-07-16 (as_of for all claims/downloads: 2026-07-16). Saved /home/user/Photo/assets/seal/doc-seal.png (1200x1200 RGBA PNG, 339 KB) rasterized with python3 cairosvg from the true-vector SVG at the source_url (repo detain/svg-logos, located via GitHub code search filename:us-department-of-commerce.svg; downloaded over verified TLS from raw.githubusercontent.com, one of the only reachable hosts). Design verified by rendering and visual inspection with PIL/Read: gold eagle crest, shield with three-masted ship on blue chief and lighthouse on gold base, ring text "DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE / UNITED STATES OF AMERICA" with two stars — matches the official DOC seal (a U.S. government work, public domain, 15 U.S.C. 1501 seal design approved 1913). Cross-checked against a second independent copy in an official U.S. government repo: GSA/USSM assets/images/governance/sopac-logos/department-of-commerce.svg (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GSA/USSM/master/assets/images/governance/sopac-logos/department-of-commerce.svg) — identical design; that file wraps an embedded 720x720 PNG (same nominal size as the Wikimedia Commons original) so the vector source was preferred for the 1200px render. Bonus completed: /home/user/Photo/assets/seal/ita-logo.png (1200x1200 PNG, 156 KB) — classic ITA emblem (eagle over globe, ring "U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE / INTERNATIONAL TRADE ADMINISTRATION") from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/detain/svg-logos/master/svg/u/u-s-department-of-commerce.svg; note ITA's post-2021 web branding uses a newer wordmark, but trade.gov was unreachable to fetch it. Both PNGs validated with PIL (Image.open + verify).
